District Lucknow, during trial.

sentences.text: Applicant was not named in the F.I.R., which was lodged by the father of the prosecutrix/victim and after the recovery of the victim in her statement recorded under Section 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. allegation of commission of rape has been levelled against the applicant and two other co-accused persons namely Anees and Bilal.

5. It is further submitted that co-accused Bilal is also known by the name of the 'Mohammad Arman'
and in the statement recorded under Section 161 and 164 Cr.P.C., the victim apart from alleging role of sexual assault on the applicant and other two co-accused persons, namely Anees and Bilal (Mohd.
Arman), have also levelled allegations of 'abetting' the commission of rape on her to the other co-accused persons, namely, Pooja, Karimun and Bushra.
Apart from alleging that, co-accused Kayyum Ahmad have also purchased her from co-accused Pooja.
6. It is vehemently submitted that all accused persons who were charge-sheeted by the police, have been granted bail by co-ordinate Benches of this Court except the applicant.

Attention of this Court has been drawn towards the bail orders pertaining to co-accused Karimun & Bushra, Anees, Kayyum Ahmad, Pooja and Mohammad Arman (Bilal) placed from Page No. 41 on wards of the paper book,
whereby vide orders dated 13.09.2019, 02.08.2019, 09.01.2020, 14.10.2019 and 16.03.2022 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application Nos. 7845 of 2019, 4838 of 2019, 10459 of 2019, 9066 of 2019 and 2697 of 2022

sentences.text: , all these co-accused persons have been granted bail.

7. It is further submitted that role of the instant applicant is identical to the role of co-accused Anees and Mohd. Arman (Bilal) and, thus, on the principle of parity, the applicant be also granted bail.

8. It is further submitted that the prosecutrix was subjected to medical examination, however, no abnormality of any kind or any injury or pathological abnormality has been found in her medical examination.
Thus, the medical evidence is not in support of the oral allegations.
9. It is also submitted that radio-logical age of the prosecutrix has been ascertained as 20 years.
Thus, she was major at the date and time of the alleged incident.
Applicant is languishing in jail in this case since 02.06.2020 and the trial is not expected to conclude the same in near future.
Applicant is not having any criminal history and there is no apprehension that after being released on bail he may flee from the course of law or may otherwise misuse the liberty.

10. Learned A.G.A., however, opposes the prayer of bail of the applicant on the ground that the applicant has committed an heinous offence and, therefore, he is not entitled to be released on bail,
but could not confront the fact that identically placed co-accused persons have been granted bail by co-ordinate Benches of this Court 11.
Having heard learned counsel for the parties and having perused the record, it is transpired that the radio-logical age of the prosecutrix has been ascertained as 20 years.
Allegations of commission of rape and also abetting the same has been levelled against co-accused persons.
All co-accused persons including those (Anees and Mohd. Arman (Bilal) to whom the role of commission of committing rape has been assigned, have been granted bail by co-ordinate Benches of this Court.

Nothing has been brought before this Court, which may suggest that the orders whereby the facility Arjun Pasi vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home, ... on 18 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/160772824/
2 of bail has been granted to the co-accused persons, has been challenged at any higher forum or has been cancelled by the same Court.

sentences.text: Applicant is languishing in jail in this case since 02.06.2020 without any criminal antecedents and the presence of the applicant may be secured before the trial court by placing adequate conditions.
Thus, having regard to the principle of parity, the facility of bail may also be extended to the applicant.

12. Keeping in view the nature of the offence, evidence, complicity of the accused, severity of punishment, submissions of the learned counsel for the parties and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I am of the considered view that applicant has made out a case for bail.
The bail application is thus allowed.

13. Let the accused/applicant- Arjun Pasi involved in above-mentioned case, be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence by intimidating/pressurizing the witnesses, during the investigation or trial.
(ii) The applicant shall cooperate in the trial sincerely without seeking any adjournment.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.
14. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.
15. Identity, status and residence proof of the applicant and sureties be verified by the Court concerned before the bonds are accepted.
16. Observations made herein-above by this court are only for the purpose of disposal of this bail application and shall not be construed as an expression on the merits of the case.
